onset.Description: Encoding onset (time 0 of the authors' epoch) in seconds from the start of the concatenated file

duration.Description: Encoding phase duration (2 s, Moraresku et al. 2025)

sample.Description: 0-based sample of the encoding onset in the concatenated file

Levels.encoding: Encoding onset of one trial (one epoch)

epoch.Description: Epoch number (1-based) = position of the trial in data.trial

epoch_onset.Description: Start of this epoch (authors' time -2 s) in the concatenated file

Condition.Description: TrialInformationTable.Condition (data_description.docx: 2 = same objects, 3 = different objects; definitions from Moraresku et al. 2025 Neurosci Bull 41:1347-1363, doi:10.1007/s12264-025-01371-x, Methods)

Levels.2: same: two identical circles shown; remember the position of the circle closer to the central cross
Levels.3: different: a square and a triangle shown; remember the position and identity of the object closer to the central cross (followed by a 2-alternative identity question: green 'A' button = triangle, red 'B' button = square)

Correct.Description: Whether the joystick response was correct (TrialInformationTable.Correct)

ResponseTime.Description: Time of reaching response by joystick (TrialInformationTable.ResponseTime, verbatim; negative values occur in the source and are not interpreted here)

DelayLength.Description: Precise length of the delay phase (TrialInformationTable.DelayLength)

AnswerButtonCorrect.Description: Correctness of the identity button response (different condition only)

AnswerButtonRT.Description: Time of the identity button response (different condition only), as stored

n_channels_rejected.Description: Number of channels flagged as rejected for this epoch in data.RjEpochChannel

StimulusPresentation.Description: 15.6-inch TFT notebook monitor; responses with an Xbox wireless controller (joystick and buttons); TTL pulse to the iEEG trigger port at each trial start (Moraresku et al. 2025 Neurosci Bull 41:1347-1363, doi:10.1007/s12264-025-01371-x, Methods)
